comments.author: Natascha
comments.body: For the guy who made the question: A comparison with the Btc is not the case; it is a trader ship, not adventurer ship: its always fitted with high cargo and due to its low wave, the speed will be penalized because the players sail it filled with goods, it also has less sails than the large clipper. In this case it will be both be slowed and with lower acceleration due to the high cargo. Thats not the case of the large clipper, which should be fitted with low cargo and waves as high as possible. Fitted with 26/30 sails, the Large clipper will have around 40 more total sails over the cruising tea clipper and the total cargo difference between both will be negligible. I gave you facts, you gave only one adjective, that being that the large clipper is "stupid". The fact is: cruising tea clipper has slightly less sails than the large clipper, so it has potentially less maximum speed. The difference is small but its there.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: And you're ignoring the effects of an extra modification on turn and wave numbers. To build a max speed LC you're forced to use two of the 4 slots for EA and Wind-resistant mast to get 110/110 sails. Leaving you 2 modifications for wave/turn boosts. A 5/5 CTC can use 3 large gaff + 2 large square + antifoul paint + large mast to get 110/110 sails, leaving 8 slots for performance boosts. It is quite easy to push a CTC to 20 turn/20 wave without Dsails, which is impossible to do on the LC while maintaining max sails. Also the 3 studding sails vs. 5 sails will make the CTC accelerate faster.
